text.p: The Maryland Public Service Commission approved the merger between Atlantic Energy and Delmarva Power, a news release issued by Delmarva said.

In August 1996, the two investor-owned utilities announced their intent to merge to form a new company, "Conectiv," that will provide energy and related products and services to customers in Maryland, Delaware, New Jersey, and Southeastern Pennsylvania, and energy to customers in Virginia, the release said.
The settlement would result in a $3.5 million rate decrease for Delmarva Power's Maryland customers, the release said.
The decrease would go into effect on the date of closing of the merger and result in an about one percent decrease in monthly bills, the release said.
The merger remains subject to approvals from various regulatory agencies.
